normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 8 wristbands.- Gulf views - Beach access - Pool access and views - 3 Adult Bikes (4 Max Per HOA)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, and an enhanced WaterColor Grill and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Stay beachfront at 30A's award-winning WaterColor Resort! Beachside #10 is a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom condo with accommodations for 8 guests and stunning Gulf views! This unit has been professionally decorated with bright white and baby blue hues in each room for the ultimate luxurious, coastal feel. In addition to the Gulf views, this condo is in a prime location of WaterColor, with the Beach Club pools, downtown WaterColor shops and restaurants, coastal dune lakes, and Seaside, all just a short walk away. The condo has 2 stories, with a king bedroom on the first floor. There is also a hallway bunk with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and an additional living area with a queen sleeper, all of which have access to a shared bathroom in the hallway. Upstairs, the open kitchen and living room have been completely updated with top-of-the-line furnishings, premium stainless steel appliances, and all-white cabinetry. There is a banquette with seating for 6 and an additional 2 seats at the breakfast bar for guests to enjoy a meal together. The kitchen also has a separate entrance to the outside, while beautiful Gulf and pool views fill the room from the other side. There is a spacious living area with 2 sofas, chairs, a flat-screen TV, and outdoor seating on the balcony. There are also 2 bedrooms on this floor, both with king beds, balcony entrances, and private bathrooms. Guests will have access to all of the pools, nature trails, and playgrounds that WaterColor has to offer. The unit also comes with 3 adult bikes that are perfect for cruising around 30A to the nearby Grayton Beach or Seaside! Don't miss your chance to stay at this fabulous beachfront condo. Book today! If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Disclaimer: All Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart is allowed per home, and rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis, with a limit of 60 vehicles allowed in the community at any time. Additionally, WaterColor condominium buildings do not have exterior outlets for charging Low-Speed Vehicles/Low-Speed Vehicles (LSVs). 360 Blue does not provide extension cords for charging. Please discuss charging needs directly with your rental company.
